actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.FileServices.open#PublicShare').parameters({token: token || '', password: password || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {valid: out.valid, passwordOk: out.passwordOk, grant: out.grant ?? null, share: out.share})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.FileServices.upload#PublicShare').parameters({token: token || '', grant: grant || null, path: path || null, fileList: contentFile == null ? null : (Array.isArray(contentFile) ? contentFile : [contentFile]), uploaderName: uploaderName || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {uploadedList: out.uploadedList || []})
